Cropstor

The simplest crop warehouse management system.

Cropstor is a web-based online database manager that allows wholesale retailers to work in collaboration with farmers to easily record all the details about their produce, including type, quantity and location.

As every record is stored on the cloud, is computerized, and easily accessible, crops get sold instantly, thus reducing the rampant wastage problem.

Retailers can search the database to get the best prices. The system also leads to lower prices for consumers as the transparency leads to a more competitive marketplace.

Most importantly, the records will be publically available depending on the settings, leading to more accountability and efficiency in food grain distribution, while simultaneously eliminating the ‘problem of plenty’.
